mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scheduled_task_policies ORDER BY task_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scheduled_task_policies( task_type,enabled,primary_trigger,reconciliation_enabled,grace_period_seconds, claim_lease_seconds,max_attempts,retry_delay_seconds,config_version,updated_by) VALUES(#{taskType},#{enabled},#{primaryTrigger},#{reconciliationEnabled},#{gracePeriodSeconds}, #{claimLeaseSeconds},#{maxAttempts},#{retryDelaySeconds},1,#{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled=VALUES(enabled),primary_trigger=VALUES(primary_trigger), reconciliation_enabled=VALUES(reconciliation_enabled),grace_period_seconds=VALUES(grace_period_seconds), claim_lease_seconds=VALUES(claim_lease_seconds),max_attempts=VALUES(max_attempts), retry_delay_seconds=VALUES(retry_delay_seconds),config_version=config_version+1, updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scheduled_task_policy_events WHERE task_type=#{taskType} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT * FROM scheduled_tasks WHERE task_type=#{taskType} AND task_key=#{taskKey}
SELECT id FROM scheduled_tasks WHERE primary_trigger_snapshot='DATABASE' AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','FAILED') AND due_at<=#{now} AND attempts<max_attempts ORDER BY due_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_tasks SET trigger_published_at=#{publishedAt}, trigger_publish_attempts=trigger_publish_attempts+1,trigger_last_error=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND primary_trigger_snapshot=#{strategy} AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','FAILED') AND trigger_published_at IS NULL

UPDATE scheduled_tasks SET trigger_publish_attempts=trigger_publish_attempts+1, trigger_last_error=#{error},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','FAILED') AND trigger_published_at IS NULL

UPDATE scheduled_tasks SET trigger_published_at=NULL,trigger_last_error=#{reason}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND primary_trigger_snapshot=#{strategy} AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','FAILED')

UPDATE scheduled_tasks SET status='PROCESSING',attempts=attempts+1,lease_until=#{leaseUntil},claimed_by=#{owner}, last_trigger_source=#{source},last_error=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','FAILED') AND due_at<=#{now} AND attempts<max_attempts AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<#{now})

UPDATE scheduled_tasks SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),lease_until=NULL, claimed_by=NULL,last_error=#{reason},version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('CREATED','SCHEDULED','FAILED')

UPDATE scheduled_tasks SET status='SCHEDULED',due_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),lease_until=NULL, claimed_by=NULL,last_error=NULL,trigger_published_at=NULL,attempts=0,version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scheduled_task_events WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY id
